title: Reduce observed reconciliation aggregate query latency

RECON-HEALTH-COUNTS-20261015.preserved_contract: Five count_* methods on ReconciliationDriftStore and PostgresReconciliationDriftStore remain intact and used by /readyz and /health.

RECON-SVC-KEYED-READS-20261019.preserved_contract: Keyed existence and binding-scoped reads remain intact.

immutable_source_evidence_inputs.summary: Proves live pantheon-reconciliation-drift container matches merge commit a1b80a026650148bfa85044514e464e6c8303792 byte-for-byte across all five service/foundation files.

Proves reconciliation_drift.drift_evaluations existing jsonb_typeof(CASE ...) count took 2500.647ms vs 798.855ms plain COUNT(*), while the other four tables' existing valid-count queries totaled 203.549ms (3.277ms + 3.541ms + 185.854ms + 10.877ms) and five connection opens totaled 85.727ms (< 100ms).

Proves EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on reconciliation_drift.drift_evaluations (63,846 live rows, 2,510 dead tuples, only drift_evaluations_pkey index) executed a Seq Scan with 101,666 shared hit + 9,611 read = 111,277 blocks in 2405.370ms due to TOASTed payload detoasting.
Withdraws stale old-checkout list_all health citation while preserving the actual hosted 5978ms (~6s) /readyz timeout observation under the unchanged 3s deadline.

hosted_observation_vs_local_verification.separation_note: The 5978ms hosted /readyz observation and 2500.647ms/2405.370ms hosted SQL measurements (with 798.855ms evaluation plain COUNT(*), 203.549ms total across the other four valid-count queries, and 85.727ms across five connection opens) are historical read-only evidence from the frozen accepted deployment (BE a1b80a026650148bfa85044514e464e6c8303792). Local PostgreSQL 16 plan measurements (3535.467ms -> 10.191ms/10.391ms) below are isolated local verification only and do not claim hosted readiness latency is resolved until originalRoot01a11 deploys and verifies hosted /readyz under the unchanged 3s deadline.

scoped_solution.owner_store_index_ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "drift_evaluations_count_idx" ON "reconciliation_drift"."drift_evaluations" ((jsonb_typeof(payload))) WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload) IN ('object', 'string')
scoped_solution.owner_store_indexed_count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "reconciliation_drift"."drift_evaluations" WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload) IN ('object', 'string') AND jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof((payload #>> '{}')::jsonb) <> 'object') AS count FROM "reconciliation_drift"."drift_evaluations" WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload) IN ('object', 'string')
scoped_solution.scope_isolation: count_index=True is enabled exclusively on PostgresReconciliationDriftStore._evaluation_records (reconciliation_drift.drift_evaluations). All other owner-store tables keep count_index=False (default) with no extra index DDL and the existing single-pass count query.

preserved_semantics.backward_compatible_rollback: Additive partial expression index created with CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS under existing table advisory transaction lock and (23505, 42P07) duplicate-DDL guard; zero heap/column/row rewrites.

bounded_local_postgresql_16_plan_evidenc.environment: Ephemeral isolated local container (docker run --rm --network none postgres:16-alpine) with 63,846 TOASTed ~12KB JSONB rows and 2,510 non-all-visible updated tuples matching live table statistics (reltuples=63846, relpages=1145, relallvisible=1056).
